title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Linear separability means that you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) to separate the classes without any overlap.

title: Analyzing the Plot
text: Look at the distribution of the orange and blue points. Can a single straight line separate the two classes?

title: Observing the Data
text: The orange points form a ring around the blue points. Can a straight line separate these two classes?
